name: Omniscience
short_description: Self-hosted MCP retrieval with bitemporal replay and audit.
long_description: Omniscience is a self-hosted, MCP-first knowledge retrieval service. It indexes your sources (code, docs, infra configs, tickets, wikis, Datadog, PagerDuty, runbooks) and exposes them as MCP tools to any AI client - Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, custom agents. Retrieval-only: returns chunks with citations, letting the calling LLM synthesize the answer. Bitemporal storage means every fact is queryable as-of any past timestamp, enabling deterministic replay for incident review and AI-action auditing. Includes blast-radius and runbook-suggestion tools tuned for SRE and platform teams.

install.uvx: uvx --from omniscience-cli omniscience mcp serve --transport stdio

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Given an incident or change, return the impacted resources via the topology graph.

tools.name: contract_info
tools.description: Return the authenticated MCP v1 contract and content-digest pin.

tools.name: find_similar_incidents
tools.description: Rank related historical incidents with cited evidence.

tools.name: generate_postmortem
tools.description: Render a deterministic, review-only postmortem draft from incident evidence.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch one complete document and its chunks by ID.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Resolve one workspace entity, optionally at a historical as_of.

tools.name: get_related_entities
tools.description: Traverse workspace-scoped graph relationships from an entity.

tools.name: incident_timeline
tools.description: Reconstruct a cited bitemporal incident timeline.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Deterministically enumerate workspace entities with filters.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List configured connectors and their freshness state.

tools.name: replay_context
tools.description: Replay the evidence visible to a consumer at a historical time.

tools.name: resolve_incident
tools.description: Compose grounded incident context from linked sources.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval across indexed sources with citations, lineage, and freshness metadata.

tools.name: source_stats
tools.description: Return source ingestion and freshness details.

tools.name: suggest_runbook
tools.description: Match an incident signature against indexed runbooks and return the top candidates with confidence.
